policies.description: Check then run safe in-project commands. Do not ask.
Read test files; run them if they look safe. Install prints a warning.
Review the diff before commit or push.
Create a git commit when the work is ready to save.
Push the current branch after a successful commit. No force push.
Review, commit, and push as one cluster.
All rights: safe-run + safe-test + ship. Install warns about safe-test.
